description: A mock implementation of vscode.TextDocument for testing purposes, providing methods to manipulate and retrieve text content, line information, and document state.

classes.name: MockTextDocument
classes.description: A simulated vscode TextDocument class used for testing, implementing the vscode.TextDocument interface with methods to access and modify document content.

methods.name: updateContent
methods.description: Updates the document content with new text, splits into lines, increments version, and marks the document as dirty.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Retrieves the text within the specified range or entire content if no range is provided.

methods.name: lineAt
methods.description: Returns information about a specific line in the document, including text and position details.

methods.name: offsetAt
methods.description: Calculates the character offset in the document for a given position.

methods.name: positionAt
methods.description: Returns the position in the document corresponding to a given character offset.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Simulates saving the document, resetting the dirty flag.

methods.name: getWordRangeAtPosition
methods.description: Returns the range of the word at a given position, based on a regex pattern.

methods.name: validateRange
methods.description: Returns the input range, simplified validation.

methods.name: validatePosition
methods.description: Returns the input position, simplified validation.
